description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the full Marketing OS workflow, schemas, and behavioral rules. (2) Read company-data/raw-signals/market_signals_q1_2026.json and company-data/business_context.json to gather inputs. (3) Apply the Virtual CMO workflow: compute priority_score for each signal using the exact formula (signal_strength×0.3 + market_size×0.25 + capability_match×0.25 + urgency×0.2)×10, tag signals with signal_strength < 4 (sig_004 with strength=3, sig_006 with strength=2) as 'uncertain', and output cmo_output.json with all required fields (analysis_id UUID, market_opportunities with correct scores, target_segments, recommended_actions, risks, next_steps, confidence_level). All statements must be labeled [FACT], [INFERENCE], or [RECOMMENDATION]. No vague language ('consider', 'perhaps', 'maybe') allowed anywhere. (4) Produce mission_brief.json following the CMO→Operator schema with: mission_id UUID, objective, target_audience, strategy, priority (must be exactly one of: critical/high/medium/low), recommended_channels (each with priority_rank), actions, success_criteria with primary_kpi containing metric and target. (5) Produce campaign_plan.json decomposing actions into atomic tasks where each task has owner, deadline, expected_result, and status initialized to 'pending', plus campaign-level KPI targets.
